name: md-vat-refund
description: Prepare a Moldova VAT refund or tax-offset application for 2026: identify the statutory route, reconcile paid and unpaid input VAT, compute the route cap, complete the approved HG93 annex 1 application, assemble proof and follow the SFS decision and Treasury payment stages. Covers export and other exemption-with-credit refunds, specified producers, leasing, ordinary capital investment, qualifying passenger vehicles, the e-Factura excess scheme and reverse-charge energy suppliers. Distinguishes repealed PPP provisions and outstanding special-programme procedures. Use after the Moldova VAT12 return has been reconciled; do not treat every VAT credit balance as refundable.
